title: It’s the End of the "Scared" Era
description: The day we walked into your home with my family, the air felt different—it was heavy with hope and a little bit of nervous energy. But the moment our families sat together, that nervousness turned into a warmth I can’t describe. Seeing my parents talk to yours, seeing them smile and realize that we were right for each other... it was the happiest moment of my life. When it was finally 'confirmed' right there in your living room, it felt like the universe had finally aligned. I looked at you, and for the first time, I didn't have to look away. Then, the day they came to our home. My house hasn't felt that alive in years. There were tears of joy, sentimental hugs, and a deep sense of peace that filled every corner. My family wasn't just accepting a new person; they were welcoming a daughter they already loved. Seeing our families laugh together over tea and sweets, knowing that "Us" was now "Official," brought a kind of happiness that stays in your bones. We went from being a secret to being a destiny, and I’ve never been more proud to be yours.
